primary_industry_taxonomy: CY-006 historical daily industry field (Eastmoney yjbb disclosure chronology; registry industry_membership_pit), as recorded in frozen PIT-B rows
classification_date_semantics: Use the CY-006 row for the trade entry signal date; only rows with source_notice_date < trade_date and industry_valid/hard_valid evidence are eligible.
join_rule: symbol + entry_signal_date exact join to frozen CY-006 daily PIT-B row; no current classification backfill and no survivor universe input.

right_tail_definitions.DEVELOPMENT_TOP10_TOP20: frozen Phase 2 development baseline trade attribution identities; no reselection
right_tail_definitions.OOS_TOP10: frozen OOS O0 trade attribution identities where available

cyclical_mapping: No authorized cyclical/defensive mapping is assumed; industry-level results only.
sector_concentration_diagnostics: maximum industry nominal portfolio weight when reliably reconstructable
